anchors.description: Near (long) edge of the loose white paper stack on the desk, from the front-left to the front-right corner of the top sheet
anchors.visible_evidence: A stack of about 15 loose white printed sheets lies on the desk; the pile is wide and shallow (width/depth about 3 in image), so the visible near edge spans the sheet's long side and the A4 long edge (297 mm) is the relevant standard length.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Could be US Letter (279 mm) instead of A4; the pile is slightly fanned, so the right corner may belong to a lower sheet, adding a few millimetres.

anchors.description: Vertical left edge of the wall-mounted whiteboard on the right wall, from top-left to bottom-left frame corner
anchors.visible_evidence: Aluminium-framed whiteboard mounted on the wall; its left vertical edge is straight in the image and its bottom sits near desk/window-sill height, a typical 0.9 m mounting; apparent proportions and mounting height favour a 1200x900 mm board.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact model unknown: a 1500x1000 or 1800x1200 board (height 1.0 or 1.2 m) cannot be excluded; corner localisation about +/-5 px.

anchors.description: Front (long) edge of the black keyboard on the left desk, from its left front corner to its right front corner
anchors.visible_evidence: Black office keyboard with a clearly wider right-hand key block (numeric keypad), matching a full-size 440-450 mm case; the near edge runs between the left and right front corners.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Model unknown; a tenkeyless board (about 360 mm) or a wide multimedia board (about 480 mm) would move the width; the keyboard is angled in plane so the corner picks are approximate.
